generalSituation: Thundery showers associated with upper-air disturbances and a southwesterly airstream affected the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea today. Locally, it was mainly cloudy with occasional showers. Showers were heavy at times at first with squally thunderstorms. The weather was hot with sunny periods in the afternoon. With the southwesterly airstream moderating, winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days, but there will still be a few showers.
forecastPeriod: Weather forecast for Hong Kong (Sunday, 16 Aug 2026)
forecastDesc: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms at first. The minimum temperature will be about 28 degrees. Very hot with sunny intervals during the day. The maximum temperature will be around 33 degrees. Light to moderate west to southwesterly winds.
outlook: Very hot with sunny intervals on Monday, and more showers in some areas with thunderstorms later. The weather will become unsettled midweek next week.
